Etruvis the Vassal is a human located in the Crucible of Storms. He is being controlled by a merciless one.

Eventide Grove is an area of the dream tree of Tirna Marwol. It is the home of Kivarr, who would also go into the once-green Darkreach, currently being overtaken by Drust from Darkreach led by Thulsketha the Binder.
The Etheric Vault is an underground area where the House of Constructs stores souls, whether to use or to let wither away.

The Etherwyrm Cage is found at in the back of the Desolate Hollow of the Maw. The cage is available during the Night Fae Assault and A Shady Place is available. Eva's Journal belongs to Eva Sarkhoff. It is found behind two bookshelves in the southwest corner of the Viewing Room in Scholomance. It is used to perform a ritual, requiring the following items. Once the ritual is complete, Eva's Enchanted Journal can be found in a room at the keep of Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands.
Eva's Femur belongs to Eva Sarkhoff. It is located in the Hall of the Damned in Scholomance. It is an ingredient for a ritual described in Eva's Journal.
Ethereal Transmogrifier is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 500 Trader's Tender. It summons an Ethereal Warpweaver.

Eva's Enchanted Journal is found at in a room at the keep of Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands. Players place it there after performing the ritual described in Eva's Journal and earning the Memory of Scholomance achievement. Interacting with journal will transport the player to the original Scholomance instance that was removed in .
Ethereum Life-Staff is an epic staff which is good for healers that drops from High Astromancer Solarian in The Eye.

Evelyn Fredericksen was previously Historian at Blizzard Entertainment's Creative Development team. She worked on developing and maintaining the lore of all Blizzard games, books and various other media, alongside Chris Metzen when he was still part of the company. She also wrote short stories for World of Warcraft. Fredericksen left the company in 2016 to become Game Designer at Six Foot.

Ethereal Portal comes from the World of Warcraft TCG * TCG Expansion: Icecrown * Card: Portal Stone * Rarity: 1/121 booster packs In 2023, it was given out as a reward to viewers of eligible Twitch streams who watched for at least four hours from May 2-9.
Everlook is a trading post run by the goblins of the Steamwheedle Cartel. It lies at the crossroads of Winterspring's main trade routes and contains a goblin laboratory.
Evie Whirlbrew is a goblin alchemy vendor located in Everlook in Winterspring.

Evonice Sootsmoker can be found at Thorium Point in Searing Gorge. With a bucket in her hand and a rolling pin in the other, its clearly obvious shes only there to cook and clean. Just don't ask her to do windows.

The Evil Twin debuff is received from Dimensional Ripper - Everlook or Ultrasafe Transporter: Gadgetzan when they malfunction (low chance).

Eviscerator is an elite white worgen that sometimes appears in Blackrock Depths. When a player enters the Ring of Law in the Depths, an arena event will occur where players have to face three waves of non-elite enemies and finally an elite mini-boss. Eviscerator is one of six possible mini-bosses that could appear. The other ones are Anub'shiah, Grizzle, Gorosh the Dervish, Hedrum the Creeper, and Ok'thor the Breaker.

Evergreen Trading Post is a trapper outpost located to the southwest of Conquest Hold in Grizzly Hills. It is overrun by Horde grunts, its previous denizens having been slain. Alliance players visit this outpost for the quest Local Support, recovering a cedar chest from the orcs. During the quest Close the Deal heavily implied that the chest contained the Scythe of Elune, however this fact is later not further explored.

The Everfrost Razor is provided as an objective for Culling Jorcuttar. Using this item on a Dead Icemaw Bear in the Hibernal Cavern will sometimes (but not always) result in gaining an Icemaw Bear Flank. The flank is then taken to an area of disturbed cave-bottom at the rear of the cave and placed among the shards and rocks. Jorcuttar appears, and (presumably) the adventurer slays it.

Everlasting Affliction is a tier-6 Warlock talent in the Affliction tree that increases the critical strike chance of Corruption, Seed of Corruption and Unstable Affliction. In addition, each time you cast Haunt (warlock talent), Drain Soul, or Drain Life, it has a chance to reset the counter of your Corruption spell on the target.

.]] Exarch is a draenei title, apparently used for military leaders. The exact context that the draenei use it in is unknown. During the Invasion of Outland period, there was usually only one exarch per zone. On Draenor, there were far fewer Exarchs than there are today - only five at a time - and they were part of the Council of Exarchs. To become an Exarch, a draenei must go through three trials. They are allowed one companion through their trials. Draenei paladins get an Exarch's Elekk as their mount.

__NOTOC__ Examiner Rowe is a Forsaken member of the Reliquary located at the Temple of Earth of Deepholm. He asks the adventurers to battle the Twilight's Hammer and to uncover their plans with Uldum. __NOTOC__ Exarch Hataaru was one of the five Exarchs, leaders of draenei society under . He was the leader of the Artificers, the engineers of the draenei. He is quite reckless in his will to support his people through technology, even though the flora of is different from the one of Argus.

Exarch Naielle is a female draenei who holds the position of Rangari Prime on the Council of Exarchs. Her position puts her in charge of the Rangari forces, which is fitting considering she strongly believes in exploring and understanding Draenor, taking a proactive approach in influencing world events. Until recently, she reported directly to , who oversaw all members of the council.

An item collection. This is not a true set; there are no bonuses if you wear more than one or all of this set. It dates back from World of Warcraft vanilla and was notably used by the classic Kor'kron Elite units. All of the pieces of this drop from level 60+ mobs in Vanilla dungeons and zones, but can most frequently be found in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj and Temple of Ahn'Qiraj.

Evermorn Hold is a outpost based in Gorgrond from the 's future. It is built upon where Evermorn Springs once were. During the war between the Lightbound and the Mag'har, Evermorn Hold was attacked by the Lightbound led by . From here, the Exarch launched an attack against Beastwatch. However, the Mag'har repelled the assault and launched their own assault on Evermorn Hold. During the assault, Exarch Orelis was personally killed by Overlord Geya'rah, Eitrigg, and a Horde champion. Following the Mag'har exodus to Azeroth, the state of the Evermorn Hold is unknown.

The Everlasting Party is the goblin afterlife. Dead goblins are buried with their most valuable and favored possessions, along with gifts bequeathed by other goblins, so that they can enjoy them in the afterlife. After the gifting ends, the funeral attendees dance on top of the coffin to usher the deceased on to the Everlasting Party.
